normalization.json-canonical: UTF-8 JSON parsed and re-serialized with sorted keys and no whitespace
normalization.text-lf: UTF-8, BOM removed, CRLF/CR to LF, exactly one trailing newline
normalization.png-critical-chunks: type+data of IHDR, PLTE, tRNS, IDAT, IEND (ancillary metadata chunks dropped)
normalization.semanticSha256: json-canonical of the episode without status and approval (the tactical content)
normalization.reviewedEpisodeSha256: COACH_APPROVAL.json value; reproduced as SHA-256 of compact JSON (key order as authored) of the matching review_history/episodes_before_approval.json entry
